intent: Liturgical-calendar-first source acquisition and coverage, without changing the live artwork selector.

authority.liturgicalRank: 1960 Rubricae Generales nn. 6-8, 9-12, 21-27, 35-62, 91-99; observed 1962 DayResolver principal, not nominal civil feast title
authority.obligation: Current canon 1246 and valid territorial norms, independent from the 1962 Roman Missal rank

editorialSequence.label: Principal feasts and major seasons
editorialSequence.description: Prioritise named high-importance celebrations, proper subjects and Holy Week; verify each date against the observed 1962 principal.

editorialSequence.label: Sundays and territorially obligatory feasts
editorialSequence.description: Second visibility/priority overlay; do not infer obligation from 1962 rank or from a list absent a verified jurisdiction.

editorialSequence.label: Every remaining observed I-class day
editorialSequence.description: Mandatory one or more truly relevant original(s) for each observed I-class day, including Sundays and privileged ferias. Explicit source identity or appointed reading evidence required.

editorialSequence.label: Pray, Formation, Scripture, Rosary, Stations, saints and devotions
editorialSequence.description: Keep existing module targets, sharing each artwork identity rather than duplicating image files or painted-subject records.

editorialSequence.label: Observed II-class days
editorialSequence.description: After I-class and modules, include Sundays, feasts, privileged ferias and vigils; not just saints.

editorialSequence.label: Observed III-class days
editorialSequence.description: Prioritise saints and distinctive appointed readings after II-class coverage.

editorialSequence.label: Observed IV-class days
editorialSequence.description: Mostly ferias; use carefully labelled seasonal/scriptural fallbacks, not invented IV-class saints.

releaseRule: Every counted source is an actual hashed acquired original and separately licensed. Source availability is not artistic, crop, rights or publication approval. Seasonal fallback never satisfies exact-feast coverage.

obligationCandidates.label: All Sundays
obligationCandidates.note: The Sunday obligation applies universally; the observed 1962 liturgical day may have a feast as its principal.

obligationCandidates.label: 1 January (current obligation: Mary, Mother of God; traditional 1962 Proper: Octave Day of Christmas)

obligationPolicy: Apart from Sundays, canonical candidates are not a claim of current obligation in Mauritius, France or any other jurisdiction. Obtain diocesan/bishops conference territorial law, suspension/transfer rules and year before asserting any location-specific obligatory date. A 1962 liturgical principal and a current obligation title may differ.

evidenceGate.classRank: production resolved day.day.main rank plus canonical observed source ID
evidenceGate.exactDayArt: artwork.tags.observed1962Identifiers includes the resolved principal ID, verified subject/appointed readings
evidenceGate.noFalseCompleteness: An unverified seasonal, title or theme match cannot meet the class I daily minimum
